newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Non-aligned states concerned over U.S. Iraq raids.
newsitem.headline: Non-aligned states concerned over U.S. Iraq raids.

text.p: Information ministers of non-aligned countries meeting in the Nigerian capital on Friday voiced concern over United States missile attacks on Iraq.

"(The countries) expressed deep concern over the adverse effect (the attacks) are likely to have on peace and security in the region and further expressed their support for the people of Iraq," a statement from the conference said.

Iraq's information minister on Tuesday called on the non-aligned countries for support. The United States fired cruise missiles at Iraq on Tuesday and Wednesday after Iraqi troops helped a Kurdish faction seize a city in northern Iraq from a rival group on Saturday.
Non-aligned information ministers have been meeting in Nigeria this week to discuss the imbalance of information between their countries and the developed world.
